run_tail_log: run tail_log to view the last 50 lines of agent.log with optional level, session, and component filters
run_tail_log_follow: run tail_log in follow mode to watch agent.log in real time with Ctrl+C to stop
run_tail_log_errors: run tail_log to view the last 100 lines of errors.log with a WARNING level filter
run_tail_log_since: run tail_log with a since parameter to show only log lines from the last hour
run_list_logs: run list_logs to print available log files with their sizes and ages
